vsm2.23:1.1: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ ‘‘paññābhāvanāya ko ānisaṃso’’ti, tattha vadāma.
vsm2.23:1.2: Ayañhi paññābhāvanā nāma anekasatānisaṃsā. Tassā dīghenāpi addhunā na sukaraṃ vitthārato ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsetuṃ.
vsm2.23:1.3: Saṅkhepato panassā nānākilesaviddhaṃsanaṃ, ariyaphalarasānubhavanaṃ, nirodhasamāpattisamāpajjanasamatthatā, āhuneyyabhāvādisiddhīti ayamānisaṃso veditabbo.
vsm2.23:2.1: Tattha yaṃ nāmarūpaparicchedato paṭṭhāya sakkāyadiṭṭhādīnaṃ vasena nānākilesaviddhaṃsanaṃ vuttaṃ, ayaṃ lokikāya paññābhāvanāya ānisaṃso.
vsm2.23:2.2: Yaṃ ariyamaggakkhaṇe saṃyojanādīnaṃ vasena nānākilesaviddhaṃsanaṃ vuttaṃ, ayaṃ lokuttarāya paññābhāvanāya ānisaṃsoti veditabbo.
vsm2.23:2.3: Bhīmavegānupatitā, asanīva siluccaye; Vāyuvegasamuṭṭhito, araññamiva pāvako.
vsm2.23:2.4: Andhakāraṃ viya ravi, satejujjalamaṇḍalo; Dīgharattānupatitaṃ, sabbānatthavidhāyakaṃ.
vsm2.23:2.5: Kilesajālaṃ paññā hi, viddhaṃsayati bhāvitā; Sandiṭṭhikamato jaññā, ānisaṃsamimaṃ idha.
vsm2.23:3.1: Ariyaphalarasānubhavananti na kevalañca kilesaviddhaṃsanaññeva, ariyaphalarasānubhavanampi paññābhāvanāya ānisaṃso.
vsm2.23:3.3: Tassa dvīhākārehi rasānubhavanaṃ hoti. Maggavīthiyañca phalasamāpattivasena ca pavattiyaṃ.
vsm2.23:4.1: Apica ye ‘‘saṃyojanappahānamattameva phalaṃ nāma, na koci añño dhammo atthī’’ti vadanti, tesaṃ anunayatthaṃ idaṃ suttampi dassetabbaṃ –
vsm2.23:4.2: ‘‘kathaṃ payogapaṭippassaddhipaññā phale ñāṇaṃ? Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi micchādiṭṭhiyā vuṭṭhāti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhāti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi vuṭṭhāti.
vsm2.23:4.3: Tampayogapaṭippassaddhattā uppajjati sammādiṭṭhi, maggassetaṃ phala’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.63) vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm2.23:4.4: ‘‘Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, ime dhammā appamāṇārammaṇā’’ (dha. sa. 1422).
vsm2.23:4.5: ‘‘Mahaggato dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo’’ti (paṭṭhā. 2.12.62) evamādīnipi cettha sādhakāni.
vsm2.23:6.1: Tattha kā phalasamāpattīti yā ariyaphalassa nirodhe appanā.
vsm2.23:6.2: Ke taṃ samāpajjanti, ke na samāpajjantīti sabbepi puthujjanā na samāpajjanti. Kasmā? Anadhigatattā.
vsm2.23:6.3: Ariyā pana sabbepi samāpajjanti. Kasmā? Adhigatattā.
vsm2.23:6.4: Uparimā pana heṭṭhimaṃ na samāpajjanti, puggalantarabhāvupagamanena paṭippassaddhattā.
vsm2.23:6.6: Attano attanoyeva pana phalaṃ samāpajjantīti idamettha sanniṭṭhānaṃ.
vsm2.23:7.1: Keci pana ‘‘sotāpannasakadāgāminopi na samāpajjanti. Uparimā dveyeva samāpajjantī’’ti vadanti.
vsm2.23:7.2: Idañca tesaṃ kāraṇaṃ, ete hi samādhismiṃ paripūrakārinoti.
vsm2.23:7.5: ‘‘katame dasa gotrabhudhammā vipassanāvasena uppajjanti? Sotāpattimaggapaṭilābhatthāya uppādaṃ pavattaṃ…pe… upāyāsaṃ bahiddhā saṅkhāranimittaṃ abhibhuyyatīti gotrabhu.
vsm2.23:7.6: Sotāpattiphalasamāpattatthāya sakadāgāmimaggaṃ …pe… arahattaphalasamāpattatthāya… suññatavihārasamāpattatthāya… animittavihārasamāpattatthāya uppādaṃ…pe… bahiddhā saṅkhāranimittaṃ abhibhuyyatīti gotrabhū’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.60).
vsm2.23:7.7: Tasmā sabbepi ariyā attano attano phalaṃ samāpajjantīti niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ.
vsm2.23:8.2: Yathā hi rājā rajjasukhaṃ, devatā dibbasukhaṃ anubhavanti, evaṃ ariyā ‘‘ariyaṃ lokuttarasukhaṃ anubhavissāmā’’ti addhānapparicchedaṃ katvā icchiticchitakkhaṇe phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjanti.
vsm2.23:9.1: Kathañcassā samāpajjanaṃ hoti, kathaṃ ṭhānaṃ, kathaṃ vuṭṭhānanti
vsm2.23:9.2: dvīhi tāva ākārehi assā samāpajjanaṃ hoti – nibbānato aññassa ārammaṇassa amanasikārā nibbānassa ca manasikārā.
vsm2.23:9.3: Yathāha – ‘‘dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā sabbanimittānañca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro’’ti (ma. ni. 1.458).
vsm2.23:10.2: Phalasamāpattatthikena hi ariyasāvakena rahogatena paṭisallīnena udayabbayādivasena saṅkhārā vipassitabbā.
vsm2.23:10.3: Tassa pavattānupubbavipassanassa saṅkhārārammaṇagotrabhuñāṇānantarā phalasamāpattivasena nirodhe cittaṃ appeti.
vsm2.23:10.4: Phalasamāpattininnatāya cettha sekkhassāpi phalameva uppajjati, na maggo.
vsm2.23:11.1: Ye pana vadanti ‘‘sotāpanno ‘phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjissāmī’ti vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā sakadāgāmī hoti. Sakadāgāmī ca anāgāmī’’ti,
vsm2.23:11.2: te vattabbā ‘‘evaṃ sati anāgāmī arahā bhavissati, arahā paccekabuddho, paccekabuddho ca buddho.
vsm2.23:11.3: Tasmā na kiñci etaṃ, pāḷivaseneva ca paṭikkhitta’’ntipi na gahetabbaṃ. Idameva pana gahetabbaṃ – sekkhassāpi phalameva uppajjati, na maggo.
vsm2.23:11.4: Phalañcassa sace anena paṭhamajjhāniko maggo adhigato hoti. Paṭhamajjhānikameva uppajjati. Sace dutiyādīsu aññatarajjhāniko, dutiyādīsu aññatarajjhānikamevāti.
vsm2.23:12.1: ‘‘Tayo kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā sabbanimittānañca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro, pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāro’’ti (ma. ni. 1.458) vacanato panassā tīhākārehi ṭhānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.23:12.2: Tattha pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāroti samāpattito pubbe kālaparicchedo.
vsm2.23:12.3: ‘‘Asukasmiṃ nāma kāle vuṭṭhahissāmī’’ti paricchinnattā hissā yāva so kālo nāgacchati, tāva ṭhānaṃ hoti. Evamassā ṭhānaṃ hotīti.
vsm2.23:13.1: ‘‘Dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā vuṭṭhānāya sabbanimittānañca manasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā amanasikāro’’ti (ma. ni. 1.458) vacanato panassā dvīhākārehi vuṭṭhānaṃ hoti.
vsm2.23:13.3: Kāmañca na sabbānevetāni ekato manasikaroti sabbasaṅgāhikavasena panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
vsm2.23:13.4: Tasmā yaṃ bhavaṅgassa ārammaṇaṃ hoti, taṃ manasikaroto phalasamāpattivuṭṭhānaṃ hotīti evamassā vuṭṭhānaṃ veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.23:14.1: Kiṃ phalassa anantaraṃ, kassa ca phalaṃ anantaranti phalassa tāva phalameva vā anantaraṃ hoti, bhavaṅgaṃ vā.
vsm2.23:14.2: Phalaṃ pana atthi maggānantaraṃ, atthi phalānantaraṃ, atthi gotrabhuanantaraṃ, atthi nevasaññānāsaññāyatanānantaraṃ.
vsm2.23:14.3: Tattha maggavīthiyaṃ maggānantaraṃ, purimassa purimassa pacchimaṃ pacchimaṃ phalānantaraṃ.
vsm2.23:14.4: Phalasamāpattīsu purimaṃ purimaṃ gotrabhuanantaraṃ. Gotrabhūti cettha anulomaṃ veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.23:14.5: Vuttañhetaṃ paṭṭhāne – ‘‘arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sekkhānaṃ anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo’’ti (paṭṭhā. 1.1.417).
vsm2.23:14.6: Yena phalena nirodhā vuṭṭhānaṃ hoti, taṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanānantaranti.
vsm2.23:15.1: Tattha ṭhapetvā maggavīthiyaṃ uppannaṃ phalaṃ avasesaṃ sabbaṃ phalasamāpattivasena pavattaṃ nāma.
vsm2.23:15.3: Paṭippassaddhadarathaṃ, amatārammaṇaṃ subhaṃ; Vantalokāmisaṃ santaṃ, sāmaññaphalamuttamaṃ.
vsm2.23:15.4: Ojavantena sucinā, sukhena abhisanditaṃ; Yena sātātisātena, amatena madhuṃ viya.
vsm2.23:15.5: Taṃ sukhaṃ tassa ariyassa, rasabhūtamanuttaraṃ; Phalassa paññaṃ bhāvetvā, yasmā vindati paṇḍito.
vsm2.23:15.6: Tasmā ariyaphalassetaṃ, rasānubhavanaṃ idha; Vipassanābhāvanāya, ānisaṃsoti vuccati.
